desc: A shared battle's stage events alike on both screens: hei_03's four Goombas shared by 2 games (Mario at rank 1, star_rank: the nozzles work from rank 1; this stage has no iron frame, so objects fall from the first attack), every attack forcing the stage's events (TTYD_STAGE_FORCE: the nozzles turn and fire and an object falls each attack (this stage has no iron frame: it starts fallen, so the objects fall from the first attack)); each stage event draws from its own random numbers, the same in both games, so every hit and the HP it meets are the same on both (each event ran a different number of frames later on each screen and drew another target, dodge or status)
